title: Finding
description: One piece of evidence about a part, wire or net from one source. A finding is a suspect, never proof, unless its source is repairos.meter (I1). Findings feed fusion.

state.description: Scan states (ok partly shifted missing, Phase 2), photo-check states (ok broken missing shifted damaged worn dirty loose unsure), wire states (unseated wrong_pin colour_mismatch open short), the assembly state reversed (a part with a polarity or orientation fitted the wrong way round, from marks visible in a photo, never from wire colour, S1), meter state out_of_range, discovery states (unexpected_*), and honesty states (not_seen_in_photo not_inspected insufficient_evidence).

confidence.description: Source's own confidence. Not calibrated; fusion recalibrates.

is_proof.description: True only when source is repairos.meter. Enforced in code.

evidence.description: Short human sentences, e.g. 'housing gap ~2 mm (still s7)'. These go to Jev.

crop_box_px.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in the source still's pixels.

crop_file.description: Full-resolution crop saved for the UI.

render_file.description: CAD render of the same view (the 'normal' reference).

reading_id.description: MeterReading id when source is repairos.meter.

measurements.description: Numbers stay here. They are converted to words before reaching Jev (S5).

offset_mm.description: Mean signed distance along the surface normal, mm.

shift_mm.description: Translation in the design frame (mm, Z up).

views.description: Number of stills or keyframes that saw the subject.

vlm_answer.description: Structured answer from the crop-pair question, when source is repairos.vision.

severity.description: For a finding with an issue, how much it matters, judged by the vision model per crop: cosmetic = looks worn but would not stop the device working; functional = could stop it working or working right; safety = could hurt someone. Absent = not judged (treated as functional).

part_words.description: A few plain words a person can use to find the part in the photo (colour, what it connects to, where it sits), from the vision model. Shown to the user; never sent to Jev as an instruction.

category.description: defect (also when absent) = something looks broken, damaged or faulty; setup = a setup or assembly state, not a broken part: a battery missing or in backwards, a cable or connector unplugged or not fully in, a cover not clipped, a screw or fuse missing (repairos.vision.assembly). Code decides it from the state, never a model word.

fix.description: For a setup finding: the plain fix a person can do, in one sentence (e.g. 'Put the batteries in, then test again.'). Shown to the user.

ref.description: part: the part name, i.e. the reference model's node name (e.g. U1 or a sub-part U1:usb), not the BOM ref; wire: the harness wire name; net: the net name.

pins.description: Optional REF.PIN ids in the design's net naming, e.g. SW1.1.
